# Textile room: loan notes

The display includes a woven tapestry from Iran and a medieval silk tapestry. The larger tapestry hangs on the north wall, away from direct sunlight. Visitors can see the repaired section near the bottom edge without touching the cloth.

A copy of the Old Testament is in the adjoining case. The catalogue records the printer and the year on the title page. Staff should check those details against the loan form before preparing a replacement label.

The lender has asked us to keep the room below 22 degrees. If the monitor records a higher reading, close the blinds and call the collections team.
